ruleDefinitions.name: GUI Input Capture - macOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to use system dialog prompts to capture user credentials

sequences.query: (process_path = "\/usr\/sbin\/osascript" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-e.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*display.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dialog.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*answer.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*admin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*administrator.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*authenticate.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*authentication.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*credentials.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*password.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*unlock.*")))
